During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Beast-Lord]] [[Brutann]] controlled many of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth's]] most vicious creatures in service to the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. Among Brutann's [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-dominated beasts was a '''wampa'''.
